depiction.primary_object: bold uppercase block letters spelling RSVP

readings.meaning: RSVP / reply to an event invitation

ambiguity: At small list sizes, four dense block letters become a cramped black bar that requires reading text rather than recognizing a shape.

example_tasks.task: Fill out the online RSVP form for Cousin Leo's bar mitzvah
Let Sarah know whether both of us can make the housewarming
Reply to the annual client appreciation dinner invite before Friday
Update spreadsheet with latest meal selections
Check the mailbox for returned response cards from out-of-town relatives
Confirm attendance and dietary restrictions for the Q3 leadership offsite
Text Uncle Bob to ask if he is bringing a plus one
Respond to the school auction invitation before the early-bird table deadline closes tonight
Send back the stamped RSVP postcard for Hannah and Greg's October wedding in Vermont
Reply to the department holiday party Evite and mark down one vegetarian entree
Message the host on Partiful to change my status from maybe to going for Saturday

reasoning: The glyph consists solely of the four letters 'RSVP' rather than a pictorial symbol, which fails as a glanceable icon at small sizes and only works in languages that use the French abbreviation. An envelope with a checkmark or a calendar invite icon serves invitation-reply tasks much better.
